content.prompt: Prove that a quadrilateral cannot have two reflex angles.

answer.short: Two reflex angles would already sum to more than $360^\circ$, contradicting the quadrilateral angle sum.
answer.worked: Suppose a quadrilateral has two reflex angles. Each exceeds $180^\circ$, so these two angles alone sum to more than $2\times180^\circ=360^\circ$. This contradicts the fact that all four interior angles sum to $360^\circ$. Therefore, a quadrilateral cannot have two reflex angles.
